title: 第7章  夜行猛虎
content_zh:
日落西山，残阳似血。
苏烬生背着一个包袱，满身血迹，朝着杂役弟子任务栏处走去。
包袱内，乃是五十株百灵草！
身上的血迹也并非他的，而是胡荣的，妖兽的！
突破境界后，他不但寻得五十株百灵草，还斩杀了两头一级初期妖兽，被他尽数吞噬。
丹田内的灵气并不算充沛，但再给他一天的时间，必然能够突破至炼气五重之境！
苏烬生的心中满是笑意，浑身仿佛有用不完的力量一般。
倘若不是因为要上交百灵草完成任务，他都不会回宗门，而是选择继续在山脉中猎杀妖兽了。
毕竟，每吞噬一头妖兽，就相当于吞噬了几百枚下品灵石。
并且只需要一刻钟时间，便可吞噬完毕。
这等速度，纵使是宗主前来，恐怕也无法比拟！
他准备将这些百灵草上交之后，便直接前往山脉中，继续猎杀妖兽，提升境界！
一年时间，重回聚灵境肯定是没有问题的，但要想达到归元境，还是要努力才行。
不多时，他便已进入紫幕神山中，目光看向远处的任务栏。
只见，一道高有六尺，身材臃肿，肥头大耳的中年男子站立，双眼如鼠，惬意的看着四周。
此人便是杂役总管，胡荣的父亲，胡羽丰！
四周则是，一道道杂役弟子身影，满脸谄媚的将手中令牌以及完成任务所需要的物品上交。
在获得相应的贡献点之后，便心满意足的离开。
无论是杂役弟子还是外门弟子，在完成任务之后都会获得贡献点。
在宗门中，贡献点可以换取下品灵石，凝气丹等修炼资源。

苏烬生看到那道身影之后，嘴角翘起了丝丝弧度，随即又迅速收起。
继而迈动步伐，神色平静的走上前去。
“总管，这是五十株百灵草，以及任务令牌！”
“放心吧！”
“嗯？”
胡羽丰先是冰冷出声，随后便是一副愕然之色，猛然看向来人。
他记得，这个任务不是交给苏烬生了吗？
自己儿子也去截杀苏烬生了，按理说，这个时候已经截杀成功了才对。
这个任务怎么可能会被完成呢？
然而，当他看到满身血迹的苏烬生后，心中更是大吃一惊，满脸不可思议的神色。
“你，你竟然完成任务了？”
“怎么了总管？”
“百灵草在山脉外围还是挺多的，所以，很轻松就找到了。”
苏烬生脸上露出一副戏谑之色，饶有兴致的开口出声。
心中则是升起几分恨意，从表情来看，杂役总管很惊讶他能够活着回来。
被截杀一事，与杂役总管脱不了干系。
也就是他如今实力不够，否则，一定要让这胡羽丰血溅当场！
虽然胡羽丰乃是杂役总管，但境界也只有炼气八重境而已。
也是依靠八竿子打不着的亲戚关系，才有了如此位置。
“还请杂役总管核对百灵草数量！”

“没，没事。”
胡羽丰从震惊中回过神来，开始清点这百灵草的数量，心中却是无神，难道胡荣并没有去截杀苏烬生？
不然的话，苏烬生是如何活着回来的？
还是说，自己儿子被苏烬生斩杀在山脉中了？
想到这里，他心中愈发不安，胡乱扫视了一眼地上的百灵草，接过令牌。
“数量正确，没有错！”
说完之后，便将此任务登记在手中册子上。
等再过片刻时间，无杂役弟子完成任务之时，他便会将这册子上交宗门。
待核对无误之后，便会将贡献点发放至相应的弟子令牌中。
苏烬生点了点头，随即便直接转身离去，方向，自然是山脉的外围。
他要继续猎杀妖兽，提升境界。
否则，杂役总管真发起疯来，他也不是对手！
胡羽丰见到苏烬生的身影消失之后，眉头拧成一团，坐立不安。
尤其是想到苏烬生那满身血迹之后，心里更是迟迟无法平静，如坐针毡。
最终，再也等不及，直接快步上山，将手中的册子上交宗门。
而后便前去寻找胡荣去了。
毕竟，胡荣可是他的独子，绝对不能出任何问题。
山脉外围，夜色浓郁，几乎伸手不见五指。
苏烬生换了身黑衣，藏匿于夜色之中，静置于古树之上，双手各握一枚下品灵石吞噬。
古树下方，沾满血迹的衣衫摆放，一股若有若无的血腥味弥漫。

寻常武者可能闻不到，但是对于嗅觉灵敏的妖兽来说，可谓是极其浓郁。
他就是想以此来吸引妖兽前来，而自己位于古树上方伏击。
以最小的代价，获取最大的利益。
毕竟，与妖兽正面抗衡，不只危险，还浪费时间。
他如今所处的位置，与先前胡荣身死的地方不同，沿着外围多走了数里的路。
因为他猜测，胡羽丰必定会前来外围寻找胡荣的踪迹。
到时候，若是发现他的话，说不好会发生什么。
所以，为了保证自己的安全，还是先暂避锋芒吧。
“吼！”
低沉的嘶吼声响起，一道庞然大物在夜色中行走，四肢健硕，双目绽放褐色光芒。
苏烬生双目猛睁，手中两枚下品灵石也被收入储物戒中，警惕的望向不远处。
当看清那妖兽之后，心中不由一阵激动。
一级中期妖兽，夜行猛虎！
这妖兽体型庞大，足有一丈多高，身上毛发呈现黑黄条纹状，四肢健硕有力，极其凶猛。
因为常常行走于夜间，故而名为夜行猛虎。
若是能够将之吞噬，即便是不能突破境界，也绝对在突破境界的临界点！
只不过，这妖兽的实力强悍，在一级中期妖兽中属于佼佼者的存在。
倘若不能一击斩杀的话，那他的处境将会极其危险。
思索间，中品凡器便已经出现手中，体内灵气运转，源源不断的输送至利剑上。
凌厉气息悄然散发而出，蓄势待发。

夜行猛虎嗅着血腥味，来到了古树之下，对着那件白衣仔细的闻了几下。
而后便开始扫视四周，似乎想要找到那受伤的猎物。
苏烬生眼中精光一闪，手中利剑展露锋芒，纵身一跃而下，利剑猛然下斩。
“断岳斩！！”
凡阶高级武技直接施展而出，威力强悍，大有力劈华山之势，恢宏磅礴。
夜行猛虎察觉上方强悍攻势之后，根本未曾查看，便已迈动四肢朝着远处躲闪而去。
作为妖兽，对于四周突发危险都极其敏感，足以在第一时间做出应对。
然而，终究还是慢了几分！
“噗！！”
剑势汹涌，直接斩去夜行猛虎后肢，鲜血划破夜空，洒落地面。
夜行猛虎身躯一个踉跄间翻了个滚，而后前肢撑起身子，后半身则落地上。
面露凶相，獠牙外露，一双褐色的瞳孔绽放杀意，死死盯着苏烬生！
“吼！！”
虎啸之声响彻山脉，枝叶震颤，霸道气息显露无疑。
然而，苏烬生却是神色不变，脸上露出一个淡然的笑容，手中利剑还带有几分血迹。
虽然这一剑未能将其斩杀，但足以让其无还手之力了！
断去后肢的夜行猛虎连行走都成了问题，早已没了威胁。
手中利剑舞动，灵气运转间，凡阶中品武技，莲花剑舞再度施展而出。
剑似莲花朵朵，却布满锋芒，径直朝着夜行猛虎杀去。
夜行猛虎自知不敌，想要逃窜，然而，速度却是缓慢无比，拖着庞大的身躯在地上留下斑斑血迹。

还未移出半丈，剑刃便已斩入头颅，顷刻间，一朵莲花形状的伤痕便已浮现。
鲜血汹涌渗透，洒落地面。
庞大尸体也瞬间没了气息，无力的倒在地上。
望着那飞速流逝的鲜血，苏烬生快步走上前去，伸手便抓在了伤口之处。
这都是灵气啊，可不能浪费啊！
神秘种子运转，强悍的吞噬能力释放而出，血肉中蕴含的狂暴灵气尽数沉入丹田。
连带着妖核中的灵气，也一并吞噬。
不过一刻钟的时间，原本健硕，血气十足的夜行猛虎就已变得皮包骨了。
仿佛在烈日下爆嗮了七天一般，成了干尸。
而苏烬生则是一副舒坦的模样，十分满意。
这一头夜行猛虎，已然让他体内灵气达到顶峰，突破境界，只差临门一脚而已。
“啊！！”
“荣儿啊！！”
就在这时，一道暴怒的嘶吼声从远处传来！
苏烬生脸上的笑容瞬间消失，神色不由肃穆几分，望向远处。
看来，胡羽丰已经知道胡荣被他所杀一事了。
接下来的日子，恐怕是不太好过了！
胡羽丰作为杂役总管，必定会将一些带有危险的任务派发给他，而后再派人暗中截杀。
一次两次无法成功，三次五次，十次八次，总能成功。
所以，必须要尽快成为外门弟子才行！

苏烬生眼中精光乍现，心中暗道一声后，将眼前夜行猛虎尸体处理掉，而后消失在了黑夜中。
content_en:
The sun sets over the western mountains, and the setting sun looks like blood.
Su Jinsheng was carrying a baggage on his back, covered in blood, and walked towards the task column for the handyman disciples.
Inside the baggage are fifty larks!
The blood on his body is not his, but Hu Rong's, the monster's!
After breaking through the realm, he not only found fifty lark grasses, but also killed two first-level early-stage monsters, all of which he devoured.
The spiritual energy in his Dantian is not abundant, but given another day, he will definitely be able to break through to the fifth level of Qi refining!
Su Jinsheng's heart was filled with smiles, and his whole body seemed to have endless power.
If it weren't for the fact that he had to hand over the lark to complete the mission, he would not have returned to the sect, but would have chosen to continue hunting monsters in the mountains.
After all, every time a monster is swallowed, it is equivalent to swallowing hundreds of low-grade spiritual stones.
And it only takes a quarter of an hour to finish devouring it.
Even if the sect leader came, he probably wouldn't be able to match this speed!
After he plans to hand over these lark grasses, he will go directly to the mountains to continue hunting monsters and improve his realm!
In one year, there is definitely no problem in returning to the Soul Gathering Realm, but if you want to reach the Returning Realm, you still have to work hard.
Not long after, he entered the Purple Curtain Mountain and looked at the task bar in the distance.
I saw a six-foot-tall middle-aged man with a bloated body, fat head and big ears standing with eyes like a mouse, looking around contentedly.
This person is the handyman in charge, Hu Rong’s father, Hu Yufeng!
All around, there were figures of handyman disciples, all with flattering faces, handing over the tokens in their hands and the items needed to complete the mission.
After obtaining the corresponding contribution points, he left with satisfaction.
Regardless of whether they are handyman disciples or outer disciples, they will receive contribution points after completing tasks.
In the sect, contribution points can be exchanged for low-grade spiritual stones, Qi-condensing pills and other cultivation resources.
After Su Jinsheng saw the figure, the corners of his mouth curled up for the slightest degree, then quickly closed down.
Then he took steps and walked forward with a calm expression.
"General manager, here are fifty larks and mission tokens!"
"Don't worry!"
"Huh?"
Hu Yufeng first made a cold sound, and then looked at the person with a look of astonishment.
Didn't he remember that this task was assigned to Su Jinsheng?
His son also went to intercept Su Jinsheng. Logically speaking, he had already succeeded in intercepting him at this time.
How could this task be accomplished?
However, when he saw Su Jinsheng covered in blood, he was even more shocked, with a look of disbelief on his face.
"You, you actually completed the mission?"
"What's wrong, Controller?"
"There are quite a lot of lark grasses outside the mountains, so it was easy to find them."
Su Jinsheng had a joking look on his face and spoke with interest.
There was a bit of hatred in his heart. Judging from his expression, the handyman was surprised that he could come back alive.
The fact that he was intercepted and killed had something to do with the handyman in charge.
That is to say, he is not strong enough now, otherwise, Hu Yufeng must be bloodied on the spot!
Although Hu Yufeng is the general manager, his level is only the eighth level of Qi refining.
It was only through his unreachable kinship that he achieved such a position.
"Please also ask the handyman to check the quantity of lark!"
"No, it's okay."
Hu Yufeng recovered from the shock and began to count the number of lark grass, but his heart was confused. Didn't Hu Rong intercept and kill Su Jinsheng?
Otherwise, how did Su Jinsheng come back alive?
Or is it that his son was killed in the mountains by Su Jinsheng?
Thinking of this, he became more and more uneasy. He glanced at the lark on the ground and took the token.
"The quantity is correct, nothing wrong!"
After finishing speaking, the task was registered in the book in hand.
After a while, when all the handyman disciples have completed their tasks, he will hand this book over to the sect.
treatAfter verification, the contribution points will be distributed to the corresponding disciple tokens.
Su Jinsheng nodded, then turned around and left. The direction was naturally towards the outskirts of the mountain range.
He wants to continue hunting monsters and improve his realm.
Otherwise, if the handyman manager really goes crazy, he will not be a match!
After Hu Yufeng saw Su Jinsheng disappear, his brows knitted together and he became restless.
Especially after thinking about Su Jinsheng's body covered in blood, he couldn't calm down and felt like he was sitting on pins and needles.
Finally, unable to wait any longer, he hurried up the mountain and handed the book in his hand to the sect.
Then he went to look for Hu Rong.
After all, Hu Rong is his only son and there must be no problems.
On the outskirts of the mountains, the night was so dark that it was almost impossible to see.
Su Jinsheng changed into black clothes, hid in the night, and stood quietly on the ancient tree. He held a low-grade spiritual stone in each hand and swallowed it.
Under the ancient tree, blood-stained clothes were placed, and a vague smell of blood filled the air.
Ordinary warriors may not be able to smell it, but for monsters with a sensitive sense of smell, it can be said to be extremely rich.
He just wanted to use this to attract the monsters, and he ambushed him above the ancient tree.
Obtain maximum benefits at minimum cost.
After all, confronting a monster head-on is not only dangerous, but also a waste of time.
The location he was in now was different from the place where Hu Rong died. He had walked several miles more along the perimeter.
Because he guessed that Hu Yufeng would definitely come to the periphery to look for traces of Hu Rong.
At that time, if he is discovered, there is no telling what will happen.
Therefore, in order to ensure your own safety, it is better to avoid the edge for the time being.
"Roar!"
A low roar sounded, and a huge creature walked in the night, with strong limbs and brown eyes.
Su Jinsheng's eyes opened sharply, and the two low-grade spiritual stones in his hand were also put into the storage ring, and he looked warily not far away.
After seeing the monster clearly, I couldn't help but feel excited.
A mid-level monster, a nocturnal tiger!
This monster is huge, more than a foot tall, with black and yellow stripes of hair on its body, strong and powerful limbs, and is extremely ferocious.
Because it often walks at night, it is called a nocturnal tiger.
If it can be swallowed, even if it cannot break through the realm, it is definitely at the critical point of breaking through the realm!
However, this monster is very powerful and is one of the best among the mid-level monsters.
If he couldn't kill him with one blow, his situation would be extremely dangerous.
While thinking about it, a medium-grade mortal weapon appeared in his hand, and the spiritual energy in his body was flowing continuously to the sword.
A sharp aura quietly exuded, ready to go.
The nocturnal tiger smelled the smell of blood, came under the ancient tree, and smelled the white clothes carefully several times.
Then he began to scan around, as if trying to find the injured prey.
Su Jinsheng's eyes flashed, and the sharp sword in his hand showed its edge. He jumped down and slashed down with the sharp sword.
"Broken Mountain Slash!!"
The high-level martial arts of the ordinary level are directly displayed, and they are so powerful that they can split Huashan Mountain with such force that they are majestic and majestic.
After the night-walking tiger noticed the powerful offensive from above, it moved its limbs to dodge into the distance without even checking.
As a monster, it is extremely sensitive to sudden dangers around it, and is able to respond immediately.
However, it was still a bit slow after all!
"Poof!!"
The sword surged forward, directly cutting off the hind limbs of the nocturnal tiger. Blood cut through the night sky and spilled onto the ground.
The nocturnal tiger staggered and rolled, then propped up its body with its forelimbs and landed on the ground with its rear half.
He had a fierce look on his face, his fangs exposed, and a pair of brown pupils with murderous intent, staring at Su Jinsheng!
"Roar!!"
The roar of the tiger resounded through the mountains, the branches and leaves trembled, and the domineering aura was undoubtedly revealed.
However, Su Jinsheng's expression remained unchanged, with an indifferent smile on his face, and the sharp sword in his hand still had a hint ofBloodstains.
Although this sword failed to kill him, it was enough to make him unable to fight back!
The nocturnal tiger with its hind limbs amputated has difficulty even walking and is no longer a threat.
The sharp sword in his hand danced, and while the spiritual energy circulated, the mid-level ordinary martial arts skill, Lotus Sword Dance, was once again displayed.
The sword is like a lotus flower, but full of sharp edges, and it goes straight towards the night-walking tiger.
The nocturnal tiger knew it was outmatched and wanted to escape. However, the speed was extremely slow, dragging its huge body and leaving blood stains on the ground.
Before it had moved half a foot away, the sword blade had already cut into the head. In an instant, a lotus-shaped scar appeared.
Blood surged through and spilled onto the ground.
The huge corpse also lost its breath in an instant and fell to the ground helplessly.
Looking at the blood flowing quickly, Su Jinsheng walked forward quickly and reached out to grab the wound.
This is all spiritual energy, don’t waste it!
The mysterious seeds circulate, the powerful devouring ability is released, and all the violent spiritual energy contained in the flesh and blood sinks into the dantian.
It also swallowed up the spiritual energy in the demon core.
In just a quarter of an hour, the originally strong and vigorous nocturnal tiger had become skin and bones.
It was as if it had exploded under the scorching sun for seven days and turned into a mummy.
Su Jinsheng, on the other hand, looked relaxed and very satisfied.
This nocturnal tiger has already reached the peak of spiritual energy in his body, and he is only one step away from breaking through.
"Ah!!"
"Rong'er!!"
At this moment, a furious roar came from a distance!
The smile on Su Jinsheng's face disappeared instantly, his expression became a little solemn, and he looked into the distance.
It seems that Hu Yufeng already knew that Hu Rong was killed by him.
The days to come will probably not be easy!
As the general manager, Hu Yufeng would definitely assign some dangerous tasks to him, and then send people to secretly intercept them.
You can't succeed once or twice, but you can always succeed three times, five times, ten times or eight times.
Therefore, you must become an outer disciple as soon as possible!
Su Jinsheng's eyes flashed with light, and after thinking secretly in his mind, he disposed of the body of the nocturnal tiger in front of him, and then disappeared into the night.
